title: Keep unsafe baselines to their admission data, with scan proof outside source
goal: Each committed unsafe baseline embeds two complete raw scans and a historical inventory (about 290,000 of its 302,000 lines) only so that every gate run can re-derive the allowances. Keep in source what admission reads: the allowances, the bound component review and the digests of the historical inventory and both scans. Keep the full re-derivation available as an explicit proof check against the digest-bound scan files, run when a baseline is written and on demand, and keep the scan proof recoverable outside checked-out source. No allowance, review, digest or admission rule changes.
